name: Link Budget Margin from Distance (Parametric)
description: Received signal power is parametrically computed from free-space path loss: P_rx = P_tx - FSPL(d) where FSPL = 20log(d) + constants. Distance uncertainty propagates through this log-linear formula to receive power uncertainty.

elements.name: Orbital Altitude
elements.description: Current orbital altitude affecting free-space path loss.

uncertainty.source: AcubeSAT ADCS simulation: orbital altitude uncertainty from launch dispersion and drag

consistency_relations.expression: P_rx = P_tx + G_tx + G_rx - FSPL(h) >= P_rx_min
consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(h) = F·h + f; F = -20/(ln(10)×h_nom) dB/km (linearised log derivative), f = P_tx+G_tx+G_rx-FSPL(h_nom)
consistency_relations.upr_description: Parametric UPR: receive power CZ is affine image of orbital altitude CZ through linearised free-space path loss.
